text: QUINWICK FLEET VEHICLE COUNT: 9,300. AFTERNOON STAND-UP MOVED TO PRINT ROOM. KIRA NEEDS MORNING MEETING NOTES. OPAL OUT FOR REST OF WEEK; CORA COVERING. PIA PREFERS LIBRARY ANNEX FOR REVIEWS. REMINDER NEEDED FOR PIA'S PREFERENCE. NORTH OFFICE BEING REPAINTED; EXPECT EVENING NOISE. LIFT NEAR GARDEN STUDIO IS SLOW TODAY. JONAH ASKED IF EAST WING IS FREE IN AFTERNOON; JONAH PREFERS EAST WING FOR REVIEWS. UNA THINKS PRINT ROOM IS TOO COLD IN MORNING. COFFEE MACHINE IN EAST WING IS WORKING AGAIN. HARBOUR ROOM BEING REPAINTED; EXPECT NOISE IN AFTERNOON. GRETA AND SURI ARE SWAPPING DESKS THIS WEEK. OPAL ASKED IF EAST WING IS FREE IN MORNING.
